<Heading

  children={"Get Device Filter Options"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/devices/filter-options"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the protocol instances that have been created and are visible to the caller, which can be used as filter conditions for /devices.
By default, all supported option categories are returned; currently, only protocols are supported. You can specify which categories to return via the 'fields' parameter; unrequested categories will not be returned. If there are no available instances, an empty array will be returned.
Local calls can return instances that are offline or have no devices; cloud calls with device authorization enabled will only return instances associated with accessible devices. Blacklisted networks and cloud-exported networks are not returned as filter options.
Instances without a public type or bit mask configured will still return id and name, with their type and networkProtocolMask explicitly set to null; internal framework types will not be returned.
This API supports both local and cloud HTTP calls. Only options are returned; device counts are not provided. This API does not interlock with other device filter conditions and does not offer a WebSocket/MCP option querying entrance.
